title: Skeleton Recall Loss for Connectivity Conserving and Resource Efficient Segmentation of Thin Tubular Structures
mechanism: Soft recall loss on a tubed label skeleton. Cheap and GPU-friendly.
adaptation: Already run here. Open item: score the trained w 0.1 fresh-seed replication and add the width diagnostic. Keep it as a benchmark baseline loss.
min_experiment: Score the existing w 0.1 replication seeds against PF (E1 relF1@2, clean-49 crack IoU, width). Kill the line if the E1 relF1@2 gain does not replicate (< 0.02).
evidence: R (TopoMortar): best topology under noisy labels, but CrackTree Dice 0.32 vs 0.78 for CEDice. E: w 1.0 widened predictions and lowered test IoU while raising E1 detection. w 0.1 narrow E1 pass.
prior_overlap: Same mechanism and conditions run (Loss row). Only the replication scoring is open.
